title: Northgate Purchases & Returns Refund Accounting Clause: Value of a Changed-Mind Special Order Refund
content:
Refund accounting clause for the changed-mind return of Northgate Special Order merchandise under Northgate Purchases & Returns, on a sale line that earned no Annual Reward.

## Clause

The changed-mind refund is the returned value — the units on the received authorization times the sale line's unit price — refunded in full and rounded half up to the cent. Where the purchase holds more than one received authorization, the changed-mind refund is worked for the one most recently requested.

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Received authorization | the purchase's return authorization showing received; with several, the one with the latest requested date |
| Units | the units on that authorization |
| Unit price | the unit price recorded on the sale line that authorization covers |
| Returned value | units multiplied by unit price |
| Changed-mind refund | the returned value, rounded half up to the cent |

## Worked figures (hypothetical authorizations)

1. One received authorization for 2 units of a sale line at 1249.99: returned value 2499.98; the changed-mind refund is 2499.98.
2. Two received authorizations on one purchase, requested on 3 June (1 unit of a line at 899.00) and on 9 June (3 units of a line at 329.50): the refund is worked for the authorization requested on 9 June, 3 multiplied by 329.50, that is 988.50.
